FINAL SQL:
SELECT Fname
FROM Student
WHERE StuID IN (
    SELECT hp1.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet hp1
    JOIN Pets p1 ON hp1.PetID = p1.PetID
    WHERE p1.PetType = 'cat'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT hp2.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet hp2
    JOIN Pets p2 ON hp2.PetID = p2.PetID
    WHERE p2.PetType = 'dog'
);
